sources.title: markrodrigo/Qwen-3.5-4B-Spatial-SQL-1.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model, Qwen-3.5-4B-Spatial-SQL-1.1, is a 4B, narrow use case, text to spatial SQL, lightly fine-tuned model. In general, its primary use case is the Natural Language command adaptation of particular geographic spatial functions as normally defined in pure SQL.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 small models: Everything you need to know
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.5 generation is a step change in small model intelligence over Qwen3. The 9B gains 15 points over Qwen3 VL 8B (17 to 32), the 4B gains 9 points over Qwen3 4B 2507 (18 to 27), the 2B gains 3 points over Qwen3 1.7B (13 to 16), and the 0.8B gains 2.5 points over Qwen3 0.6B (6.5 to 9).
